description: A small controlled format authored for the Sextant statistical inference tests. It exercises a magic signature, a packed flags byte whose high five bits are constant and low three bits vary, a record count, and that many fixed-size records.

provenance.origin: Authored by hand for the Sextant project and generated by corpus/scma/generate.py.
provenance.notes: Not derived from any third-party file or specification. Safe to redistribute.
